micchattaniyāma: [Micchatta+niyāma] (ti) CL=7 Has inevitable results from wrongness.

micchāpatthanā: [Micchā+patthanā] (thī) CL=7 Wishing by the wrong way.
micchāpatti: [Micchā+patti] (thī) CL=7 Reached (or) attained in the wrong way. Reached the state of wrong practice.
micchāpavattana: [Micchā+pavattana] (na) CL=7 Happens in the wrong views.

micchāsabhāva: [Micchā+sabhāva] (pu) CL=7 (1) Wrong nature. (Ti) (2) Has the wrong nature.
micchāsamādhi: [Micchā+samādhi] (pu) CL=7 (1) The wrong awareness. Micchāsamādhi.  (Ti) One who has wrong awareness.
micchāsamādhipaccaya: [Micchāsamādhi+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is wrong awareness. That happens due to wrong awareness.
micchāsamādhipaṭikkhepa: [Micchāsamādhi+paṭikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Rejection of the wrong awareness.
micchāsamādhippahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāsamādhippahāna+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 Rejection of wrong awareness that appears in the wisdom.
micchāsamādhisamugghātaka: [Micchāsamādhi+samugghātaka] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī samugghātikā.] A cause that rejects wrong awareness.
micchāsamādhisamugghātikā: [Micchāsamādhi+samugghātikā] (thī) CL=7 A cause that rejects wrong awareness. See - Micchāsamādhisamugghātaka.

micchāsamādhividdhaṃsikā: [Micchāsamādhi+viddhaṃsikā] (thī) CL=7 Destroyed wrong awareness. See - Micchāsamādhividdhaṃsaka.
micchāsamādhivūpasamapaccaya: [Micchāsamādhivūpasama+saccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is the cessation of wrong awareness.
micchāsamādhiya: [Micchāsamādhi+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who has the wrong awareness.
micchāsati: [Micchā+sati] (thī) CL=7 (1) Wrong awareness. Micchāsamādhi. (Ti) One who has wrong awareness.
micchāsatipaccaya: [Micchāsati+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is wrong awareness. That happens due to wrong awareness.
micchāsatipahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāsatippahāna+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 The rejection of wrong awareness that appears in the wisdom.
micchāsatipaṭipakkha: [Micchasati+paṭipakkha] (pu) CL=7 The opposite of wrong awareness.
micchāsativiniddhunana: [Micchāsati+viniddhunana] (ti) CL=7 Shakes off and destroys wrong awareness.
micchāsaññāṇa: [Micchā+saññāṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who has the wrong perception.
micchāsaṅkappa: [Micchā+saṅkappa] (pu) CL=7 (1) The wrong thoughts. Wrong contemplation. Micchāsaṅkappa, Micchāvibhaka. (Ti) (2) One who has the wrong intention.
micchāsaṅkappabahula: [Micchāsaṅkappa+bahula] (ti) CL=7 One who has a lot of wrong intentions.
micchāsaṅkappacetanā: [Micchāsaṅkappa+cetanā] (thī) CL=7 The will of a person having intention with wrong views. The intention is related to wrong contemplation or thought.
micchāsaṅkappagocara: [Micchāsaṅkappa+gocara] (ti) CL=7 One who is in the field of wrong concepts.
micchāsaṅkappanighātaka: [Micchāsaṅkappa+nighātaka] (ti) CL=7 Completely destroys the wrong concepts.
micchāsaṅkappapaccaya: [Micchāsaṅkappa+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is a wrong thought. That happens due to a wrong thought.
micchāsaṅkappapahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāsaṅkappappahāna+paccupaṭṭhana] (ti) CL=7 The rejection of the wrong thought that appears in the wisdom.
micchāsaṅkappavuṭṭhāna: [Micchāsaṅkappa+vuṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Rising out from the wrong intention.
micchāsaṅkappita: [Micchāsaṅkappa+ita] (ti) CL=7 One who has wrong intentions.
micchāvatthuka: [Micchā+vatthu+ka] (ti) CL=7 Has a located place that is wrong views. That has located place which is the wrong views (or) doctrines.
micchāvaṇijjakamma: [Micchāvaṇijjā+kamma] (na) CL=7 Trading in the wrong way (or) unsuitable way.
micchāvaṇijjā: [Micchā+vaṇijjā] (thī) CL=7 Trading in the wrong way (or) unsuitable way.
micchāvikappa: [Micchā+vikappa] (pu) CL=7 Intention in the wrong views.
micchāvikapparahita: [Micchāvikappa+rahita] (ti) CL=7 Free from wrong thoughts (or) intentions.

micchāvimutti: [Micchā+vimutti] (thī) CL=7 (1) Wrong liberation. Taking liberation from demerits that is not liberation (from the cycle of suffering). (2) One who assumes has been liberation (who is not liberated from the cycle of suffering).
micchāvimuttika: [Micchāvimutti+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who has the wrong liberation.
micchāvimuttipaccaya: [Micchāvimutti+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 Has a cause that is wrong liberation. Happens due to the wrong liberation.
micchāvimuttipariyosāna: [Micchāvimutti+pariyosāna] (ti) CL=7 Has the end that is the wrong liberation.
micchāvimuttiñāṇadassana: [Micchāvimutti+ñāṇadassana.] (na) CL=7 (1) Understanding and insight as libration by the wrong views (but it is not liberated from the cycle of suffering). micchāvimuttiñāṇadassanapaccaya: [Micchāvimuttiñāṇadassana+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is Micchāñāṇa which is understanding and insight as liberation by the wrong views. (actually, it is not liberation from the cycle of suffering).
micchāvimuttiñāṇadassanika: [Micchāvimuttiñāṇadassana+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who is understanding an insight as liberation by the wrong views. (actually, it is not liberation from the cycle of suffering).
micchāvitakkabahula: [Micchāvitakka+bahula] (ti) CL=7 One who has a lot of wrong thoughts.
micchāvitakkacora: [Micchāvitakka+cora] (pu) CL=7 Micchāvitakka that is so-called a thief.
micchāvitakkalesa: [Micchāvitakka+lesa] (pu) CL=7 A fraction (or) hint of Micchāvitakka. A small part of wrong thought.
micchāvitakkamakkhikā: [Micchāvibhakka+makkhikā] (thī) CL=7 The wrong thoughts that are (Kāmavitaka, Vihisavitaka) which is like a fly, honey-bee.
micchāvitakkana: [Micchā+vitakkana] (na) CL=7 Contemplation in the wrong views. The wrong thought.
micchāvitakkodaka: [Micchāvitakka+udaka] (na) CL=7 Water that is the wrong thought.
micchāvitakkodakabharita: [Micchāvitakkodaka+bharita] (ti) CL=7 It is filled with water that is wrong thoughts.
micchāviññāṇa: [Micchā+viññāṇa] (ti) CL=7 Has wrong awareness. One who has the wrong awareness.
micchāvācappahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāvācappahāna+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 A state of affairs that appears on the wisdom which rejects the wrong words (sound).
micchāvācā: [Micchā+vācā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Speaking wrongly. The wrong (or) incorrect words (sound). (2) One who is speaking wrongly.
micchāvācāpaccaya: [Micchāvācā+paccaya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is wrong words (sound). Happens due to wrong words (sounds).
micchāvācāppahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāvācappahāna+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 A state of affairs that appears on the wisdom which rejects the wrong words (sound).
micchāvācāvirati: [Micchāvācā+virati] (thī) CL=7 Abstinence from wrong words (sound). One who is avoidance of speaking wrongly. See - Sammāvācā.
micchāvādavidhamana: [Micchāvāda+vidhamana] (na) CL=7 Destruction of the wrong belief (or) doctrine.
micchāvādavigamana: [Micchāvāda+vigamana] (na) CL=7 Going away from the wrong belief (or) view.
micchāvādī: [Micchāvāda+ī] (ti) CL=7 One who has wrong views (or) beliefs.
micchāvāyāma: [Micchā+vāyāma] (pu) CL=7 (1) An effort that is done in the wrong way. The wrong effort. Micchā- vāyāma. (Ti) (2) One who is striving in the wrong way.
micchāvāyāmapaccaya: [Micchāvāyāma+maccāya] (ti) CL=7 A cause that is striving in the wrong way. It arises due to striving in the wrong way.
micchāvāyāmappahānapaccupaṭṭhāna: [Micchāvāyāmappahāna+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 A state of affairs that appears in the wisdom which rejects striving in the wrong way.
micchāvāyāmopatthambhita: [Micchāvāyāma+upatthambhita] (ti) CL=7 Supported by striving in the wrong way.
micchāvāyāmupatthambhita: [Micchāvāyāma+upatthambhita] (ti) CL=7 Supported by striving in the wrong way.
micchāvāyāmūpatthambhita: [Micchāvāyāma+upatthambhita] (ti) CL=7 Supported by striving in the wrong way.
micchāvītikkama: [Micchā+vītikkama] (pu) CL=7 Violent in the wrong ways.
micchāyasa: [Micchā+yasa] (pu) CL=7 Wrong attendants (or) wrong reputation. See - Micchāladdha.
micchāñāṇa: [Micchā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 Wrong understanding. Wrong contemplation.  moha. micchāñāṇa. Incorrect knowledge. See - Micchāñāṇa.
micchāñāṇappaccaya: [Micchāñāṇa+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) A cause that is wrong understanding. (Ti) (2) That has a cause which is micchāñāṇa. That has a cause which is wrong understanding.
micchāñāṇī: [Micchāñāṇa+ī] (ti) CL=7 Wrong understanding. Wrong contemplation. One who has incorrect knowledge.
micchāājīva: [Micchā+ājīva] (pu) CL=7 (1) Wrong livelihood. Micchāājīva. See original.
micchāājīvapaccaya: [Micchāājīva+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) A cause that is the wrong livelihood. (Ti) (2) That has a cause that is being with the wrong livelihood.
micchāājīvavirati: [Micchāājīva+virati] (thī) CL=7 Abstaining from the wrong livelihood.
micchāṭhapita: [Micchā+ṭhapita] (ti) CL=7 It is placed (or) put in the wrong way (or) portion.
micchāṭhapitasālisūka: [Micchāṭhapitasāli+sūka] (pu) CL=7 The spike of a fragrant grain that is placed at the wrong portion.
midati: [Mida+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Mida modamedhā-hiṃsāsasu. Midati. Nīti,dhā.97. Mida bhūdicu sineha. Dhātvattha.190.] Loves and attaches.
middha: [Mida+ta]  CL=9 (1) Drowsiness, laziness. Unworkableness- inertness- unwieldiness of the three aggregates of mental factors. (2) Sleep. See  Middhasukha. Medha+ta. Miha+ta. Medhatīta middhaṃ. Abhi,ṭṭha,1. 409. Accantaparissa- mādikāraṇā sabbaṅganimīlanaṃ middhaṃ. Mucchāpāyaṃ middhaṃ. Mida kāriyakkhamane, to. Medhayati va middhaṃ, akammaññabhāvena vihiṃsatītyattho. Dhāna,ṭī.176. middhahetuka: [Middha+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 A root cause that is drowsiness. It arises due to drowsiness.
middhaniddesa: [Middha+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 A phrase that is an analytical description of drowsiness. Middhaniddesa.
middhapaṭikkhepa: [Midda+paṭikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Rejection of Middha (physical form). Rejects a person of a belief that is having Middharūpa.
middharūpa: [Middha+rūpa] (na) CL=7 Middharūpa. (Object of the eye) form that is sluggishness or drowsiness.
middhasamāruḷha: [Middha+samārūḷha] (ti) CL=7 (Person, mind) who reaches a state of drowsiness.
middhavinodanakammaṭṭhāna: [Middhavinodana+kammaṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Meditation subject that is removing drowsiness.
middhī: [Middha+ī] (ti) CL=7 One who is afflicted by drowsiness.

migabandhanī: [Miga+bandhani] (thī) CL=7 The cast net. A net to catch animals.
migabhūta: [Miga+bhūta] (ti) CL=7 (One"s mind) that resembles a deer"s mind.
migabyadha: [Miga+vidha+a] (pu) CL=7 [Mige vijjhatīti migabyadho, dhāna,ṭī.518.] A hunter or animal catcher or deer catcher.

migachāpa: [Miga+chāpa] (pu) CL=7 [In Thī migachāpā, migacchapikā.] A young animal or prey.
migadhenu: [Miga+dhenu] (thī) CL=7 A female deer. See also - Dhenu.
migadāya: [Miga+dā+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Migānaṃ abhayaṃ deti etthāti migadāyo. Sī,ṭī,saca,2.346.] A place where is wildlife sanctuary. Migadāya.
migadāyavihāra: [Migadāya+vihāra] (pu) CL=7 A monastery or residence named Migadāya. See also - Migārañña.
migaganthanī: [Miga+gantha.miga] (thī) CL=7 [Ganthati bandhatībhi migaganthanī. Migabandhanītipi pāṭho. Dhāna,ṭī.520.] A cast net. A net that is to catch game animals or prey.
migagaṇaparivuta: [Migagaṇa+parivuta] (ti) CL=7 One who is surrounded by deer.
migagaṇapatta: [Migagaṇa+patta]  CL=9 who reaches all deer/wild animals; one.
migaghaṭā: [Miga+ghaṭā] (thī) CL=7 All of a group of animals.
migajeṭṭhaka: [Miga+jeṭṭhaka] (pu) CL=7 The chief of animals or prey. A lion who is a chief of animals or prey. See - Migādhibhū.
migajāla: [Miga+jāla] (pu) CL=7 (1) One who is named Migajāla. (Na) (2) A cast net or net to catch animals or prey.
migajāta: [Miga+jāta] (pu) CL=7 A group of animals or prey.
migaketusanāmaka: [Migaketū+sanāmaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is named Migeketu.
migalakkhaṇa: [Miga+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 Auspicious marks of deer or prey.
migalomapakata: [Migaloma+pakata] (ti) CL=7 (The flooring sheet) that is made of wool.

migaluddaka: [Migaludda+ka] (pu) CL=7 A deer hunter or a huntsman.
migaluddakageha: [Migaluddaka+geha] (na) CL=7 A house of a huntsman or deer hunter.
migaluddakagāma: [Migaluddaka+gāma] (pu) CL=7 A village of a huntsman named Migaluddaka.
migaluddakagāmaka: [Migaluddakagāma+ka] (pu) CL=7 A small village of a huntsman named Migaluddaka.
migaluddakakula: [Migaluddaka+kula] (na) CL=7 Hunter lineage or huntsman race.
migaluddakaparisā: [Migaluddaka+parisā] (thī) CL=7 The audience of a huntsman.
migaluddakopamā: [Migaluddaka+upamā] (thī) CL=7 A simile that is a huntsman or animal catcher.
migamada: [Miga+mada] (pu) CL=7 [Miga+mara+a. Migassa mado migamado, migo marati yenāti vāmigamaro, so eva migamado. Dhāna,ṭī.303.] Musk.
migamagga: [Miga+magga] (pu) CL=7 The path of the deer.
migamandalocana: [Miga+mandalocana.migiya] (ti) CL=7 [Viya mandāni locanāni assāti migamandalocanā. Jā,ṭṭha,5. 226-7.] One whose eyes are like a female deer"s eyes and has soft eyes or tender gaze.
migamaṃsalobha: [Migamaṃsa+lobha] (pu) CL=7 A desire for deer meat.
migamāraṇa: [Miga+māraṇa] (na) CL=7 Killing the animal or causing the deer to die.
migamāraṇakīḷā: [Migamāraṇa+kīḷā] (thī) CL=7 Killing deer for sport. See - Migava.
migamāraṇasatti: [Migamāraṇa+satti] (thī,pu) CL=7 A spear for killing deer.
migamātukā: [Migamātu+ka+ā] (thī,pu) CL=7 [Sabbesampi migānaṃ mātuṭṭhāne tiṭṭhatīti migamātukā, upamāne ko. Dhāna,ṭī.619.] Hare-deer. A prey or animal named Migamātuka.
migamāyā: [Miga+māyā] (thī) CL=7 The fraud of deer. The deceit of deer.
migantara: [Miga+antara] (pu) CL=7 Different kinds of animals or a variety of animals or prey.
migapadavalañjananiddesa: [Migapadavalañjana+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 Instructed by the method of Migapadavalañjana.
migapotaka: [Miga+potaka] (pu) CL=7 [In Thī miga-potikā.] A small deer.
migapotakavatthu: [Migapotaka+vatthu] (na) CL=7 The story of a young deer and Sambur.
migaratha: [Miga+ratha] (pu) CL=7 A coach that is driven by deer.
migarohiccavaṇṇa: [Migarohicca+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 The appearance of a banteng (animal).
migarāja: [Miga+rāja] (pu) CL=7 King of the animals or a lion who is a king of the animals.
migarājagata: [Migarāja+gata] (ti) CL=7 One whose walking style is like a lion.
migarājaputta: [Migarāja+putta] (pu) CL=7 The son of a lion or king of the animals.
migarūpa: [Miga+rūpa] (na) CL=7 (1) Deer. A group of deer. (2) The appearance of the deer.
migasadda: [Miga+sadda] (pu) CL=7 (1) Miga-saddāa. (2) The voice of a deer.
migasaddasavana: [Migasadda+savana] (na) CL=7 Hearing the sound of deer.
migasahassaparivāra: [Migasahassa+parivāra] (ti) CL=7 One who is surrounded by one thousand deer.
migasammatābhimukha: [Migasammatā+abhimukha] (ti) CL=7 One who is facing to Migasammatā River.
migasammatānadītīra: [Migasammatānadī+tīra] (na) CL=7 On the banks of the Migasammatā River.
migasamūha: [Miga+samūha] (pu) CL=7 All the deer or a herd of deer.
migasatti: [Miga+satthi] (pu,na) CL=7 The dry meat from the thigh of a deer.

migasaṅgha: [Miga+saṅgha] (pu) CL=7 All the deer or a herd of deer.
